g000.content: A single Sprite2D cannot hold multiple textures, so multiple collision polygons must be creatable and drawable in the editor viewport for the asteroid.
g000.title: Multiple editor-drawable collision polygons required for asteroid

g001.content: The asteroid script extends CharacterBody2D and implements set_asteroid_variant(index). It uses a $CollisionVariants node holding CollisionPolygon2D templates and a preloaded list of four asteroid textures, wrapping the index, and copies the matched template polygon's points into the active $CollisionPolygon2D.
g001.title: Asteroid variant script structure

g002.content: Because asteroid variants have different collision shapes, the collision-relevant variant must be decided authoritatively on the server. Asteroid appearance is gameplay-irrelevant and may often be decided by the client.
g002.title: Server authority over asteroid collision variant

g003.content: The Bullet scene and the Asteroid scene have been built in Godot.
g003.title: Bullet and Asteroid scenes built

g004.content: Bullets and asteroids must first be spawned locally in Godot; integration cannot be implemented before spawning works.
g004.title: Spawn locally in Godot before networking integration

g005.content: Current scope is limited to asteroid spawning and despawning.
g005.title: Scope limited to asteroid spawn/despawn

g006.content: Asteroids must spawn off-screen, travel in a roughly random direction toward the player, have a random size between 1 and 4, and use a random texture with matching collision shape, which the asteroid script already handles.
g006.title: Asteroid spawn and movement requirements
